transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Yeah. Um... I guess I'm here because I just keep... blowing up at people. Over nothing, really. I've been snapping on my operations calls at work, and... even at my family. It's just... that's not how I've ever handled things before.
Can you describe what happens right before you snap at someone? Do you feel a build-up of anger, or does it come on suddenly without much warning?

I don't... I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed a build-up or anything like that. 

It just kind of... happens. One minute I'm just listening on a call, and the next I'm just... going off. I don't really know.
Have you had episodes like this before, or is this something that’s only started recently?
No, it's... it's new. It started about three weeks ago. Just... after this incident at work. There was a valve failure at the facility, and... someone got hurt. It's just been since then.
Can you talk a bit more about that incident at work where someone got hurt? How did you feel during and immediately after it happened?

I... I don't really know what to say about it. The valve gave out, and... it was bad. 

As for how I felt... I don't know. I didn't really think about it. You just... deal with the situation, you know? You just do what you have to do. I don't really want to get into the whole thing, to be honest.
Since the incident at work, have you had any flashbacks, nightmares, or times when you felt like you were back in that moment?

Yeah... I guess. Sometimes. 

Like, I'll just be sitting at the kitchen table, or... trying to answer emails from home. And suddenly... I'm right back there. Just... seeing the flash from that valve again. The smoke in the aisle. It just... it shoves everything else out of my head. 

I don't really know how else to explain it.
Since the incident at work, have you found yourself avoiding certain places, people, or activities because they remind you of what happened?

I mean... I haven't been back to work. I'm on leave right now. 

Other than that... I don't know. I just stay home mostly. I haven't really been doing much of anything.
Since the incident at work, have you noticed that you're more irritable or angry than usual, even when you're not having flashbacks or thinking about the event?

Yeah. I guess that's... part of why I'm here. 

I just... keep blowing up at people. Over nothing, really. I'll be on an operations call from home and just snap. Or... I'll snap at my family. 

It's just... I've never handled things like that before. I don't know why I'm doing it now.
Since the incident at work, have you found yourself being more on edge or easily startled by things that wouldn’t have bothered you before?

Yeah. I guess. Just... noises, mostly. 

If I hear a forklift beep, or... a compressor kick on. Even if it's just the smoke alarm chirping at the house. My whole body just... tightens up. I catch myself looking for the exits. Just waiting to see what's gonna go wrong next. 

I don't know.
